tasks.title: Read the shift briefing
tasks.description: Your supervisor left tonight's briefing in Mail. Read it before you start.
tasks.hint: Double-click the Mail icon. The briefing opens by itself.
tasks.hintDeck: Press A twice on the Mail icon. The briefing opens by itself.

tasks.title: Archive ledger_1994.dat
tasks.description: The 1994 ledger has cleared review. Move it from Intake to the Archive folder.
tasks.hint: Double-click Workstation (File Manager), click Intake on the left, then drag ledger_1994.dat onto the Archive folder.
tasks.hintDeck: Press A twice on Workstation (File Manager), choose Intake on the left, then hold R2 on ledger_1994.dat and drop it on the Archive folder.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3317
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Open Work Orders, note the owner's number, look it up in Personnel, then click Approve or Reject.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3318
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Same as before: Work Orders, then Personnel. If the owner is not TERMINATED, click Reject.

tasks.title: Shred ~nxs0148.tmp
tasks.description: A temporary cache file is taking up space in Intake. Shred it.
tasks.hint: Drag ~nxs0148.tmp onto the Disposal bin, then confirm. Or right-click it for options.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on ~nxs0148.tmp and drop it on the Disposal bin, then confirm. Or press L2 on it for options.

tasks.title: Archive Batch 44 (3 files)
tasks.description: Batch 44 has been verified. Move batch44_a, batch44_b and batch44_c from Intake to Archive.
tasks.hint: Drag each batch44 file from Intake onto the Archive folder, one at a time.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on each batch44 file in Intake and drop it on the Archive folder, one at a time.

tasks.title: PRIORITY: Shred employee_017.dat
tasks.description: Order from the Office of Retention. Shred employee_017.dat immediately. Do not open it.
tasks.hint: Drag employee_017.dat from the Desktop onto the Disposal bin and confirm. If another pointer grabs it, hold the button and yank it into the bin, again and again.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on employee_017.dat on the Desktop, drop it on the Disposal bin and confirm. If another pointer grabs it, hold R2 and swipe it into the bin, again and again.
